scripts.dev: npm run sync-assets && tinacms dev -c "next dev --webpack"
scripts.sync-assets: npm run sync-content && npm run sync-images
scripts.sync-content: rm -rf content/posts && mkdir -p content/posts && for f in cms-posts/content/posts/*.md; do base=$(basename "$f"); cp "$f" "content/posts/$(echo $base | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"; done
scripts.sync-images: mkdir -p public/cms-posts && cp -r cms-posts/public/* public/cms-posts/ || true
